title: RecXR SMP
description: A Simple SMP Server with Vanilla+ Plugins that allow Deeper Automation, Waypoints, and more!
body:
# RecXR SMP
Welcome to RecXR, We focus on creating a **Vanilla+ Experience** by adding things like **Futher Automation Capability**, **Waypoints**, **A Lives System**, and a Few More to keep things Fresh, All Custom Made!

This uses Playit.gg on a Raspberry Pi 5, so thats why **It May Be Slow**, and is Why It has a Weird IP.
